scope: Apply the E58 critique findings everywhere they recur on Pages 24-29, with fixes made in the design system so pages inherit them instead of being edited one by one.
approach: Every component pattern was audited on Page 24 and on all active pages (archive sections included where the prototype reaches them), then fixed in the owning component; page-level edits were limited to wiring and copy that Figma stores per instance.

Figma prototype links can only target screens on the same page, so navigation cannot live in Page 24 components. Links now live on the control instances themselves, which move with any later component change; menus and pickers that only change state use interactive components (variant changes), which work on every page.
Token re-tuning was rejected: color/hover drives 129 approved composer layers and 27 slider layers, so control/raised contrast is fixed inside the affected components instead.
